overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation. The Committee posted notices for the September 10, 13, and 16, 2021 meetings more than 48 hours ahead on its official website posting location, and the notices were easily accessible.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged the Committee failed to properly post notice 48 hours ahead of its September 10, 13, and 16, 2021 meetings.
Complaints alleged notice was not properly posted, including that the September 16 notice was not on the website's Calendar page 48 hours before the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Although notices were posted in two different locations, we find that the notices here were easily accessible.
